records.requirement: Track long-term vision, goals, projects, milestones, tasks, decisions, blockers, progress evidence, completed work, deferred work, and next safe actions.
records.proof: The repo now has structured goals, execution records, blockers, decisions, completed items, deferred items, follow-up actions, and evidence records.
limitations: The full routed Command Center module is not implemented.
Repository hygiene blockers still prevent foundation readiness claims.
records.next_action: Keep mission coverage visible in the static Goal Tracking Center while the routed Command Center shell remains planned.

records.requirement: Create a clear hierarchy from SEIS vision through evidence records and follow-up actions.
records.proof: The goal schema and long-term goal registry define vision, themes, goals, phases, milestones, epics, tasks, validation, evidence, and follow-up structure.
limitations: Hierarchy is a foundation model and still needs deeper app-level navigation.
records.next_action: Use the hierarchy as the stable source for future Command Center routing and filters.

records.requirement: Track all required strategic categories with current status, milestone, blockers, evidence links, and next action.
records.proof: The structured registry validates 20 goals across the 20 required strategic categories and the view model exposes category status.
limitations: Several categories remain planned or blocked because implementation evidence is not available.
records.next_action: Keep planned and blocked categories visible until real implementation evidence changes their status.

records.requirement: Command Center should include a Goal Tracking Center that shows active goals, roadmap, blockers, evidence, validation, readiness, and platform progress.
records.proof: A generated non-LLM view model, static Goal Tracking Center page, and static Command Center shell expose progress cards, blockers, next actions, validation, readiness, planning, and progress records.
limitations: The shell is static and is not a dynamic routed application runtime.
No live GitHub, release, or SSH integration is claimed.
records.next_action: Keep the static shell evidence-backed and defer dynamic routing until repository hygiene blockers are isolated.

records.requirement: Create or improve the required docs under docs/goals, docs/product, docs/roadmap, and docs/reviews.
records.proof: All required Goal Tracking OS deliverables exist and are included in the local goal tracking validator.
limitations: Document existence does not prove full product implementation.
records.next_action: Keep docs index, status, backlog, and PR queue synchronized when the deliverable set changes.

records.requirement: Every active goal should have evidence or be marked as planned, and evidence must avoid fake progress, unsupported validation, and sensitive material.
records.proof: The evidence ledger validates records, relative paths, limitations, and scoped safe-text checks, while planned goals remain planned when evidence is unavailable.
limitations: Scoped sensitive-pattern checks are not a full repository secret-history scan.
records.next_action: Run broader public-readiness security checks after repository hygiene is resolved.

records.requirement: Create practical daily, weekly, and monthly review cadence without fake performed reviews.
records.proof: Daily, weekly, and monthly review cadence records and templates exist, one current daily review log was performed on 2026-06-20, one current weekly review log was performed for 2026-W25, and one current monthly review log was performed for 2026-06.
limitations: This proves the cadence foundation only; future recurring reviews still require current-period evidence.
records.next_action: Continue adding dated review logs only when current-period evidence exists.

records.requirement: Define a lightweight goal object with id, title, category, status, target, dependencies, evidence, validation, review, and next action fields.
records.proof: The schema document and validator enforce required goal fields, allowed statuses, priorities, risk levels, arrays, evidence links, blockers, and next actions.
limitations: The data model is intentionally lightweight and not yet a database schema.
records.next_action: Use the lightweight model as the fixture contract before any database or live adapter work.

records.requirement: Show goal list, milestone progress, blockers, next actions, evidence, roadmap, readiness, AI Core, Command Center, and research progress without fake progress bars.
records.proof: The generated page and static shell render numeric cards, active and blocked goals, next actions, validation, readiness, planning, progress, decisions, and guardrails without progress bars or completion percentages.
limitations: The broader app navigation is static and not a dynamic routed runtime.
Milestone timeline is represented through planning and milestone fields, not a dedicated timeline component.
records.next_action: Add dynamic routing and a milestone timeline only after the current static contract remains stable.

records.requirement: Keep the goal tracking system structured, inspectable, auditable, and useful without depending entirely on an LLM.
records.proof: The registry, validator, view generator, and static page run locally from structured files without a model provider connection.
limitations: Future LLM assistance can still be added, but it must not override evidence-backed states.
records.next_action: Keep LLM assistance optional and route any future summarization through evidence-aware status rules.

records.requirement: Prioritize goal structure, milestone map, backlog, next PR queue, schema, product doc, progress template, evidence, roadmap connection, and Command Center connection.
records.proof: The foundation priority list is represented across docs, backlog, PR queue, structured records, validator, view model, static page, and static Command Center shell.
limitations: The dynamic Command Center application runtime is planned, not complete.
Repository hygiene blockers still control the next safe PR.
records.next_action: Resolve repository hygiene blockers, then promote the static shell toward a dynamic Command Center runtime.
